hero_desc: Authentic, generous cuisine orchestrated by Chef Cédric Barquant.
intro_text1: In our kitchen, every plate tells a story: that of a carefully selected product from committed local producers, grown with respect and transformed with passion. Favouring products rooted in the region guarantees unrivalled freshness while supporting those who keep our Flanders alive.
badge_title: ⭐ Recognised as a “Table Remarquable” by Teritoria
badge_desc: A distinction that honours our commitment to sincere, eco-responsible gastronomy.
chef_desc1: Our chef, Cédric Barquant, joined the establishment in June 2026. Previously sous chef at the Château de Beaulieu (**) and then executive chef at the Auberge du Vertmont, he is devoted to working with seasonal produce with passion, rigour and innovation.
chef_desc2: “With a menu that changes with the seasons and varied weekly menus, we offer honest cooking to awaken your taste buds!”
wine_desc1: To enhance the chef’s creations, we offer our wine list, carefully selected with passion by L’Homme du Vin, our main supplier and partner.
wine_desc2: 🍷 You can also enjoy a fine selection of wines by the glass, reinvented with the seasons to perfectly accompany your meal.
menu_dates: From Monday 2 November to Sunday 8 November 2026
m_formula: Set menu — Starter + Main course or Main course + Dessert: €38 (drinks not included)
